_comment: LAST CALL 3 v0.2.5 item catalogue (Items loads this; ItemManager runs the effects). cat: movement offensive defensive economic medical ghost rules roulette room. use: board (before you roll), passive (works by itself while you carry it), ghost (a ghost's turn), roulette, room (away from the table), other (on someone else, special). target: none | player | ghost | choice. price: base Teeth price (shops multiply). rarity: common | uncommon | rare | contraband. lasts: how long it works. icon: glyph drawn on its card.

loaded_dice.name: LOADED DICE
loaded_dice.desc: Pick LOW (1-3) or HIGH (4-6). Your next roll lands in that range.

high_roller.name: HIGH ROLLER
high_roller.desc: Roll a ten-sided die (0-10) this turn.

double_roll.name: DOUBLE ROLL
double_roll.desc: Roll twice and keep the better one.

loaded_double.name: LOADED DOUBLE
loaded_double.desc: Two dice, both weighted to land 3-6, added together.

warp_tooth.name: WARP TOOTH
warp_tooth.desc: Swap places on the board with someone else.

shortcut_key.name: SHORTCUT KEY
shortcut_key.desc: Opens the next toll gate for free (THE MEAT LOCKER, the hidden panel). Used up when it does.

greased_shoes.name: GREASED SHOES
greased_shoes.desc: Three extra spaces on this roll.

reverse_gear.name: REVERSE GEAR
reverse_gear.desc: Walk backwards this turn (the Dead Rat might be behind you).

pickpocket.name: PICKPOCKET GLOVE
pickpocket.desc: Take up to 6 Teeth from someone. They'll know it was you.

rat_trap.name: RAT TRAP
rat_trap.desc: Set it on your square. The next person to land there loses 8 Teeth and a finger's worth of hand.

poisoned_gift.name: POISONED GIFT
poisoned_gift.desc: Give someone a lovely box. It looks like a GIFT BASKET to them. Opening it poisons them.

tooth_tax.name: TOOTH TAX
tooth_tax.desc: Someone pays the house 5 Teeth. You get nothing but the satisfaction.

sabotage_kit.name: SABOTAGE KIT
sabotage_kit.desc: Rig someone's equipment: they're slower and weaker in the next minigame.

debt_collector.name: DEBT COLLECTOR
debt_collector.desc: Everyone who owes you pays now, with half again on top.

lucky_tooth.name: LUCKY TOOTH
lucky_tooth.desc: Carried, it stops one bad square, bad event or tax. Then it's just a tooth.

safety_pin.name: SAFETY PIN
safety_pin.desc: Carried, it stops the next trap or injury.

body_armour.name: BODY ARMOUR
body_armour.desc: Put it on: the next three injuries are one step milder.

bribe_token.name: BRIBE TOKEN
bribe_token.desc: Carried, the next time he decides what to do about you (late back, a Caller square, a punishment), he's kinder.

helmet.name: PARTY HELMET
helmet.desc: Wear it: the next thing that would kill you only maims you.

counterfeit_teeth.name: COUNTERFEIT TEETH
counterfeit_teeth.desc: Twelve Teeth, right now. Each round there's a chance he notices they're plaster: you lose 15 and look guilty.

loaded_wallet.name: LOADED WALLET
loaded_wallet.desc: Eight Teeth, rattling about in someone else's wallet.

insurance.name: INSURANCE POLICY
insurance.desc: Carried: the next time you lose 5+ Teeth, an item, a body part or your life, it pays out 10 Teeth.

gift_basket.name: GIFT BASKET
gift_basket.desc: Give someone 5 of your Teeth and something nice. People remember kindness. So does he.

debt_note.name: DEBT NOTE
debt_note.desc: Lend someone 6 Teeth. They owe you 10, paid when they pass START (or when you collect).

black_market_coupon.name: BLACK MARKET COUPON
black_market_coupon.desc: Opens the black market for you right now, at half price, with the stock under the counter.

first_aid.name: FIRST AID TIN
first_aid.desc: Clears bruises and burns and sets one broken bone.

painkillers.name: PAINKILLERS
painkillers.desc: For three rounds, injuries slow you less.

prosthetic.name: PROSTHETIC
prosthetic.desc: A brass replacement for something you've lost.

surgery.name: SURGERY KIT
surgery.desc: Mends every broken part and cuts out necrosis.

alibi.name: ALIBI
alibi.desc: Someone else did it. Twenty off your suspicion.

loaded_die.name: CHEATER'S DIE
loaded_die.desc: Contraband. Your next roll is a six (if he doesn't see you swap it in).

hairpin.name: HAIRPIN
hairpin.desc: Picks a lock. Away from the table.

gavel.name: GAVEL
gavel.desc: Pass a law: choose one of three amendments and it's in the rulebook.

loophole.name: LOOPHOLE
loophole.desc: For three of your turns, the amendments don't apply to you.

rubber_stamp.name: RUBBER STAMP
rubber_stamp.desc: Every temporary amendment lasts three turns longer.

executive_privilege.name: EXECUTIVE PRIVILEGE
executive_privilege.desc: Strike one amendment out of the rulebook, permanent or not.

cold_hand.name: COLD HAND
cold_hand.desc: Ghosts only. The next square someone lands on does nothing for them.

phantom_coin.name: PHANTOM COIN
phantom_coin.desc: Ghosts only. Tip the next random event two steps better (BLESS everyone) or worse (CURSE the leader).

last_will.name: LAST WILL
last_will.desc: Carried when you die: your Teeth don't rot with you. You keep them as a ghost, and the poorest living player gets half again from the estate.

possession_ticket.name: POSSESSION TICKET
possession_ticket.desc: Ghosts only. Get into the machinery: the Dead Rat jumps to another spot on the board.

grave_ticket.name: GRAVE TICKET
grave_ticket.desc: Ghosts only. The next time anyone lands on a resurrection square, it's you who comes back.

lazarus_rat.name: LAZARUS RAT
lazarus_rat.desc: Give it to a ghost: they come back.

spinner.name: SPINNER
spinner.desc: Russian Roulette: spin the cylinder again.

peeker.name: PEEKER
peeker.desc: Russian Roulette: look into the next chamber (only you see).

skip.name: SKIP CARD
skip.desc: Russian Roulette: pass your turn without pulling.

mirror.name: HAND MIRROR
mirror.desc: Russian Roulette: your shot goes at someone else.

bribe.name: ENVELOPE OF TEETH
bribe.desc: Russian Roulette: pay someone to take your turn (if they'll take it).

bullet.name: A SPARE ROUND
bullet.desc: Contraband. Russian Roulette: load another chamber.

gift.name: GIFT BASKET?
gift.desc: Someone gave you this. Open it.
